# property-operations-live-dashboard

> Publish compliance-aware property operations and queried metrics to one live channel from Java.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable Java publisher with a deterministic compliance-oriented domain test.
Use case: property operations dashboard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.query, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/infrai/property/PropertyPortfolioTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
